text.tspan: Using safely managed sanitation facilities: urban vs. rural population
Share of the population using a safely managed sanitation service in urban versus rural areas. Safely managed means human
waste is safely disposed of in situ or treated off-site.
Share of the rural population using safely managed sanitation
Share of the urban population using safely managed sanitation

text.textPath: Urban and rural populations are equally likely to use safely managed sanitation
Urban and rural populations are equally likely to use safely managed sanitation
Urban population is twice as likely to use safely managed sanitation
Urban population is twice as likely to use safely managed sanitation

text.tspan: Data source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Note: Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
